stated: The Conservative Party will toughen community sentencing by increasing the use of community payback and electronic tagging, ensuring criminals repay their debt to society and communities see justice served.

source.quote: We will toughen up community sentencing by increasing the use of community payback and electronic tagging, so criminals pay their debt to society and communities witness justice being served.

bearing_set.reason: Directly affects the justice system's sentencing outcomes, offender supervision, and visible community accountability — core indicators of whether justice works and streets/communities feel safe.

Electronic tagging is a state surveillance tool that tracks individuals' location and movement (a concrete O10 privacy/surveillance indicator), and community payback mandates compelled labour under state supervision (freedom from state coercion indicator); 'toughening' these measures expands both coercive elements.

membership_note: Two clear bearings: O5 on the protective/justice side (does tougher community sentencing reduce crime and deliver justice?), and O10 on the liberty/surveillance side (electronic tagging and compelled community work are coercive state powers applied to sentenced individuals). Fiscal effects on O12 are plausible but likely minor and indeterminate in direction (community sentences are cheaper than custody but more intensive supervision costs money); not non-negligible enough to include without a clearer mechanism.
